tasks.title: Meta path map + frameStore storage seam
tasks.whatChanged: Added FRAME_META_FILES (the .frame/-relative meta path map) and LEGACY_ROOT_FILES to src/shared/frameConstants.js, and built src/main/frameStore.js — a data-shaped API (readTasks/writeTasks, structure, notes, quickstart, config, the project AGENTS layer) with separately named …Path(projectPath) entries for the watchers, .frame/bin/ scripts and AI-tool-facing files that need a real path. Covered by 12 cases in test/frameStore.test.js.
tasks.whyChanged: The API returns data rather than paths so the later move to a Frame-owned store is a backend swap behind these functions instead of a second pass over every caller. JSON reads pass fsSafe's { data, source, error } envelope through untouched — collapsing it to data||null would re-introduce the silent-null failure tasksManager grew out of. Diverged from plan.md on ORCH_META_FILES: left as bare file names, because both consumers match a footprint entry's basename, which is already layout-agnostic; .frame/-relative paths there would have silently killed every match.

tasks.title: Route tasksManager and overviewManager through frameStore
tasks.whatChanged: tasksManager now reads/writes through frameStore (the fsSafe envelope arrives from the store, so the corruption-recovery contract is unchanged) and its watcher derives its directory from the store's path entry instead of assuming the project root. overviewManager's loadStructure/loadTasks/loadDecisions lost their hand-built root paths. test/tasksManager.test.js and test/specTasksSync.test.js moved their fixtures to .frame/tasks.json, plus two new cases: writes never escape .frame/, and a pre-overlay root tasks.json is not read as live data.
tasks.whyChanged: Beyond plan.md's Files: specManager.js:1063 kept its own fs.watch on the root tasks.json — a watcher my change would have left pointed at a path that no longer exists, so it now takes the same frameStore.tasksPath. Also outside the plan, test/specTasksSync.test.js seeded a root tasks.json fixture and would have failed. The 'tasks-root' activity-watcher label was deliberately left alone: renaming it would touch the WATCHERS enum in activityEvents.js for a cosmetic gain.

tasks.title: Conditional .git/info/exclude state machine
tasks.whatChanged: New src/main/gitExclude.js: resolves the exclude file via `git rev-parse --git-path info/exclude` (worktree- and submodule-safe), then no repo → no-op, .frame/ tracked → remove our entry, untracked → add it. Wired into frameProject.js at both the project-open IPC and the top of runProjectInit, before the first .frame/ artifact exists. 12 cases in test/gitExclude.test.js run against real temp git repos.
tasks.whyChanged: plan.md specified a single signed line, `.frame/  # managed by Frame …`. That does not work: gitignore syntax has no trailing comments, so git reads the whole thing as a literal pattern and excludes nothing — the entry looks right in the file and hides nothing. The signature moved to its own comment line above the pattern, added and removed as a block; the broken single-line form is still recognized so an older Frame's entry gets collapsed rather than orphaned. Removal only ever touches a signed entry, so a hand-written `.frame/` rule survives.
